"""Review a song: stem loudness per section, spectrogram images, click scan."""
import importlib
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SRC = os.path.join(HERE, "compose", "src")
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SRC, "vendor"))
sys.path.insert(0, SRC)
os.environ.setdefault("NUMBA_CACHE_DIR", os.path.join(HERE, "numba-cache"))

import matplotlib  # noqa: E402
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
from scipy import signal  # noqa: E402

from engine import dsp, mixer  # noqa: E402
from engine.dsp import SR  # noqa: E402


def rms_db(x):
    return 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2)) + 1e-12)


def spec_png(L, R, path, title, t0=0.0, t1=None):
    x = 0.5 * (L + R)
    a = int(t0 * SR)
    b = int((t1 or len(x) / SR) * SR)
    x = x[a:b]
    f, t, S = signal.spectrogram(x, SR, nperseg=4096, noverlap=3072, scaling="spectrum")
    S = 10 * np.log10(S + 1e-12)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(16, 9), gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [3, 1]})
    ax[0].pcolormesh(t + t0, f, S, vmin=S.max() - 90, vmax=S.max(), shading="auto", cmap="magma")
    ax[0].set_yscale("symlog", linthresh=200)
    ax[0].set_ylim(30, 20000)
    ax[0].set_title(title)
    env = np.abs(x).reshape(-1, 441)[:, :].max(axis=1) if len(x) % 441 == 0 else np.abs(x[: len(x) // 441 * 441]).reshape(-1, 441).max(axis=1)
    ax[1].plot(np.arange(len(env)) * 0.01 + t0, env, lw=0.5)
    ax[1].set_xlim(t0, t0 + len(x) / SR)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=70)
    plt.close(fig)


def clicks(L, thresh=0.25):
    d = np.abs(np.diff(dsp.hpf(L, 8000, order=4)))
    idx = np.where(d > thresh)[0]
    return idx


def main(name, t0=None, t1=None):
    mod = importlib.import_module("songs." + name)
    song = mod.build()
    (L, R), stems = mixer.render(song, stems=True)
    out = os.path.join(HERE, "review")
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"{song.title}: master {dsp.lufs(L, R):.1f} LUFS, len {len(L) / SR:.1f}s")
    # per-section stem loudness (dB RMS), relative to master
    secs = [(s.name, song.sec(s.start), song.sec(s.start + s.length)) for s in song.sections]
    names = list(stems)
    hdr = f"{'section':<13}" + "".join(f"{n[:9]:>10}" for n in names) + f"{'MASTER':>10}"
    print(hdr)
    for sname, a, b in secs:
        ia, ib = int(a * SR), int(b * SR)
        row = f"{sname:<13}"
        for n in names:
            sl, sr_ = stems[n]
            v = rms_db(0.5 * (sl[ia:ib] + sr_[ia:ib]))
            row += f"{v:>10.1f}" if v > -90 else f"{'-':>10}"
        row += f"{rms_db(0.5 * (L[ia:ib] + R[ia:ib])):>10.1f}"
        print(row)
    spec_png(L, R, os.path.join(out, f"{song.slug}_full.png"), song.title)
    if t0 is not None:
        spec_png(L, R, os.path.join(out, f"{song.slug}_zoom.png"), f"{song.title} {t0}-{t1}s", t0, t1)
    c = clicks(L)
    print(f"click-like transients above 8 kHz: {len(c)}" + (f" first at {c[:5] / SR}" if len(c) else ""))
    corr = np.corrcoef(L, R)[0, 1]
    print(f"stereo correlation {corr:.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    main(args[0], *(float(a) for a in args[1:3]))

"""02 Neon Pursuit: fast chase synthwave in F# minor, 146 BPM.

The riff sits on an F# pedal and alternates F#m with Gmaj7/F#, a Phrygian
flat-two that gives the chase its menace (G natural against the tonic), and
closes E -> C#7 with the harmonic-minor leading tone E#. The verse runs
i - VImaj7 - iv7 - v7 in F# minor; the pre-chorus climbs the bass B-C#-D-E
into the relative major, where the chorus lands on A and lifts again through
a borrowed flat-three: C - D - E - A (bIII - IV - V - I).
"""
from engine.score import Song
from songs.common import (SW_FILL_SNARE, SW_FILL_TOMS, bass, brass, drums, fx, pluck, saw_lead,
                          square_lead, warm_pad)

RIFF_CH = "F#m | Gmaj7/F# | F#m | Gmaj7/F# | F#m | Gmaj7/F# | E | C#7"
VERSE_CH = "F#m | Dmaj7 | Bm7 | C#m7 | F#m | Dmaj7 | Esus4 E | C#7"
PRE_CH = "Bm | C#m | D | E"

    s = Song("Attract Mode", "attract-mode", 124, "D", "major", seed=303, genre="Synthwave")
    s.bus.update(rev_rt60=2.0, dly_beats=0.75, dly_fb=0.3)
    lead = s.track("lead", square_lead(cutoff=2600.0, env_amt=1.2, pw=0.36, vib_depth=0.18),
                   program=80, check=True, level=-17, rev=0.15, dly=0.2)
    chp = s.track("chip", chip(duty=0.25), program=80, check=True, level=-19, rev=0.1, dly=0.2,
                  pan=-0.15)
    dbl = s.track("double", chip(duty=0.125), program=80, check=True, level=-25, rev=0.12,
                  dly=0.2, pan=0.2)
    keys = s.track("keys", ep(index=1.8, decay=2.0), program=5, level=-21, rev=0.2, chorus=0.4,
                   pan=0.1, duck=0.15)
    pad = s.track("pad", warm_pad(cutoff=1800.0, a=0.6), program=89, level=-26, rev=0.3,
                  chorus=0.5, duck=0.3, width=1.2)
    arp = s.track("arp", pluck(cutoff=900.0, fd=0.1), program=84, level=-27, dly=0.3, rev=0.1,
                  pan=-0.25)
    bs = s.track("bass", bass(cutoff=420.0, env_amt=4.0, fd=0.09, drive=1.2), program=38, level=-18,
                 duck=0.2)
    dr = s.track("drums", drums(snare_tune=1.1), program=0)
    fxt = s.track("fx", fx(), program=99, level=-26, rev=0.35)
    ARP = ["1", "3", "5", "8", "10", "8", "5", "3"]

    sec = s.section("attract", 8, INTRO_CH)
    sec.mel(chp, JINGLE)
    sec.mel(lead, TEASER, bar=4)
    sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm=COMP, vel=84)
    sec.pad(pad, "D3", "A4", 3)
    sec.bass(bs, POP_BASS, bars=(4, 8))
    sec.drums(dr, DR["fusion"], bars=(4, 8), fills={7: SW_FILL_SNARE})
    sec.fx(fxt, "reverse", bar=2, beats=8)

    def verse(name, text):
        sec = s.section(name, 8, VERSE_CH)
        sec.mel(lead, text)
        sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm=COMP, vel=82)
        sec.arp(arp, ARP, lo="D4", rate=0.25, vel=70)
        sec.bass(bs, POP_BASS)
        sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"], fills={7: SW_FILL_SNARE})
        sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0)

    def pre(name):
        sec = s.section(name, 8, PRE_CH)
        sec.mel(lead, PRE)
        sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x...x...x...x.x.", vel=80)
        sec.pad(pad, "D3", "A4", 3)
        sec.bass(bs, "R:q R R R")
        sec.drums(dr, DR["fusion"], fills={7: SW_FILL_TOMS})
        sec.fx(fxt, "riser", bar=6, beats=8)

    def chorus(name, chords, text, tonic=None, doubled=False, lowv=False):
        sec = s.section(name, 8, chords, tonic, "major" if tonic else None)
        sec.mel(lead, text, transpose=1 if tonic else 0)
        if doubled:
            sec.mel(dbl, text, transpose=(1 if tonic else 0) + 12 if not lowv else -12)
        sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm=COMP, vel=86)
        sec.pad(pad, "D3", "A4", 3)
        sec.arp(arp, ARP, lo="D4", vel=72)
        sec.bass(bs, "R:e O R O R O R O")
        sec.drums(dr, DR["chorus"], fills={7: SW_FILL_TOMS})
        sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0)
        return sec

    verse("verse", VERSE_A)
    verse("verse 2", VERSE_B)
    pre("pre")
    chorus("chorus", CHORUS_CH, CHORUS)

    sec = s.section("high score", 8, HISCORE_CH)
    sec.mel(chp, HISCORE, vel=100)
    sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm=COMP, vel=80)
    sec.bass(bs, POP_BASS)
    sec.drums(dr, DR["fusion"], fills={7: SW_FILL_SNARE})
    sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0)

    verse("verse 3", VERSE_B)
    pre("pre 2")
    chorus("chorus 2", CHORUS_CH, CHORUS)

    sec = s.section("bridge", 8, BRIDGE_CH)
    sec.mel(chp, BRIDGE, vel=100)
    sec.pad(pad, "D3", "A4", 4)
    sec.pad(keys, "E4", "B5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x.......x.......", vel=84)
    sec.bass(bs, "R:q. R:e O:q R")
    sec.drums(dr, DR["bridge"], fills={7: SW_FILL_TOMS})
    sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0)
    sec.hit(dr, "crash", 4)
    sec.fx(fxt, "riser", bar=6, beats=8)

    chorus("final chorus", FINAL_CH, CHORUS, tonic="Eb", doubled=True, lowv=True)
    chorus("final chorus 2", FINAL_CH, CHORUS, tonic="Eb", doubled=True)

    sec = s.section("outro", 8, OUTRO_CH)
    sec.mel(lead, OUTRO)
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, hold=False, rhythm=COMP, vel=80, bars=(0, 6))
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, vel=78, bars=(6, 8))
    sec.pad(pad, "Eb3", "Bb4", 3)
    sec.bass(bs, POP_BASS, bars=(0, 6))
    sec.bass(bs, "R:w", bars=(6, 7))
    sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"], bars=(0, 6), fills={5: SW_FILL_SNARE})
    sec.hit(dr, "crash", 6)
    sec.hit(dr, "kick", 6)
    return s

PYTHONPATH=pylib:compose/src/vendor python3 -c "
from midi_composer_mcp.counterpoint import species_counterpoint
from midi_composer_mcp.notes import parse_note
from midi_composer_mcp.generate import parse_rhythm
CF=['C#4','E4','D#4','F#4','E4','A4','G#4','F#4','D#4','C#4']
CONS={0,3,4,7,8,9}
for sp in (1,2,3,4,5):
  r = species_counterpoint(CF,'C#','natural minor',species=sp,position='above')
  cp = r['counterpoint']; rh = r.get('counterpoint_rhythm'); st = r['counterpoint_step_beats']
  # onset times
  if rh:
    steps=[i for i,c in enumerate(rh) if c!='.']
  else:
    steps=list(range(len(cp)))
  bad=[]
  for n,s in zip(cp,steps):
    t=s*st; bar=int(t//4); pos=t%4
    c=parse_note(CF[bar]).midi; m=parse_note(n).midi
    iv=(m-c)%12
    if iv not in CONS: bad.append(f'bar{bar+1}+{pos:g}:{n}/{CF[bar]}={iv}')
  print(sp, rh, cp)
  print('   dissonant onsets:', bad)
"

"""04 Sunset Cabinet: slow synthwave / city-pop in Db major, 84 BPM.

Last light over the boardwalk arcade. The verse rocks between Dbmaj7 and
Bbm9 with a rising-sixth motif (Ab4 up to F5). The chorus uses the
IVmaj7 - III7 - vi7 - v7 I7 chain (Gbmaj7 F7 Bbm7 Abm7 Db7), whose borrowed
A natural (in F7) and Cb (in Abm7 and Db7) give it the city-pop ache. The
bridge turns to Bb minor and climbs by sixths to an F6 peak.
"""
from engine.score import Song
from engine.instruments import Bell
from songs.common import SW_FILL_TOMS, bass, drums, ep, fx, pluck, saw_lead, warm_pad

INTRO_CH = "Gbmaj7 | Fm7 | Ebm7 | Absus4 Ab"
VERSE_CH = "Dbmaj7 | Bbm9 | Gbmaj7 | Ab6 | Dbmaj7/F | Gbmaj7 | Ebm7 | Absus4 Ab"
PRE_CH = "Ebm7 | Fm7 | Gbmaj7 | Ab7sus4 Ab7"
CHORUS_CH = "Gbmaj7 | F7 | Bbm7 | Abm7 Db7 | Gbmaj7 | F7 | Bbm7 | Ebm7 Ab7"
BRIDGE_CH = "Bbm9 | Gbmaj7 | Ebm9 | F7sus4 F7 | Bbm9 | Gbmaj7 | Ebm9 | Ab7sus4 Ab7"
OUTRO_CH = "Gbmaj7 | Fm7 | Ebm7 | Absus4 Ab | Dbmaj9 | Dbmaj9"

VERSE_A = """
r:e F4:s Ab4 C5:q. Db5:e F5:q | Eb5:q. Db5:e C5 Bb4~ Bb4:q |
r:e Gb4:s Bb4 Db5:q. F5:e Ab5:q | F5:q. Eb5:e C5:h |
r:e F4:s Ab4 C5:q. Db5:e Ab5:q | Gb5:q. F5:e Db5 Bb4~ Bb4:q |
Bb4:e Db5 Eb5 Gb5~ Gb5:q F5:e Eb5 | Db5:h C5
"""
VERSE_B = """
r:e F4:s Ab4 C5:q. Db5:e F5:q | Eb5:q. Db5:e C5 Db5~ Db5:q |
r:e Bb4:s Db5 F5:q. Gb5:e Bb5:q | Ab5:q. F5:e Eb5:h |
C6:q. Bb5:e Ab5 F5~ F5:q | Gb5:q. F5:e Db5:h |
Eb5:e F5 Gb5 Bb5~ Bb5:q Ab5:e Gb5 | Eb5:h. r:q
"""
PRE = """
Bb4:q Db5 Gb5:q. F5:e | Ab5:h. Eb5:e F5 | Bb5:h. Ab5:e F5 | Db6:h C6:q Gb5
"""
CHORUS = """
Bb5:q. Ab5:e F5:q Db5 | C6:q. A5:e F5:q Eb5 | Db6:q. C6:e Bb5:q F5 | Eb5:q Cb5 F5 Ab5 |
Bb5:q. Ab5:e F5:q Db6 | C6:q. Eb6:e C6:q A5 | Bb5:h. Ab5:e F5 | Gb5:q Bb5 C6:h
"""
BELLS = """
Db6:e Bb5 F5 Bb5 Db6 F6 Eb6 Db6 | C6:e Ab5 F5 Ab5 C6 Eb6 C6 Ab5 |
Bb5:e Gb5 Eb5 Gb5 Bb5 Db6 Bb5 Gb5 | Ab5:e Eb5 Db5 Eb5 C5:h
"""
BRIDGE = """
F5:q. Db6:e~ Db6:h | C6:q. Bb5:e~ Bb5:h | Gb5:q. Eb6:e~ Eb6:h | Bb5:h A5 |
Db6:q. F6:e~ F6:h | Eb6:q. Db6:e~ Db6:q Bb5 | Gb5:q. F5:e~ F5:q Eb5 | Db5:h C5
"""
OUTRO = """
Bb5:q. Ab5:e F5:q Db5 | C5:h. Ab4:q | Bb4:q. Gb4:e Db5:h | Eb5:h C5 | F5:w | r:w
"""

DR = {
    "verse": {"kick": "x.........x.....", "snare": "....x.......x...", "hat": "o.o.o.o.o.o.o.o.",
              "shaker": "gogogogogogogogo"},
    "chorus": {"kick": "x.....x...x.....", "snare": "....x.......x...", "clap": "....o.......o...",
               "hat": "xoxoxoxoxoxoxoxo", "ohat": "..............o."},
    "bridge": {"kick": "x.......x.......", "snare": "........x.......", "hat": "o...o...o...o..."},
}
FILL = {"kick": "x.......", "snare": "....x.x.xxxx", "tom1": "........x...", "tom2": "..........x.",
        "tom3": "............xxxx"}
FILL = {"kick": "x.......x.......", "snare": "....x...........", "tom1": "........xx......",
        "tom2": "..........xx....", "tom3": "............x.x."}


def build():
    s = Song("Sunset Cabinet", "sunset-cabinet", 84, "Db", "major", seed=404, genre="Synthwave")
    s.bus.update(rev_rt60=3.2, dly_beats=0.75, dly_fb=0.42, gated_rt60=1.1, gate_hold=0.32)
    s.master.update(lufs=-12.5)
    lead = s.track("lead", saw_lead(waves=("saw", "tri"), cutoff=1250.0, env_amt=1.3, fa=0.02,
                                    a=0.025, glide=0.07, vib_depth=0.26, vib_rate=5.2,
                                    vib_delay=0.35, r=0.45),
                   program=81, check=True, level=-17, rev=0.3, dly=0.28)
    bells = s.track("bells", Bell(ratios=(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.1), amps=(1.0, 0.35, 0.14, 0.07),
                                  decay=1.8, gain=0.2),
                    program=8, check=True, level=-23, rev=0.35, dly=0.3, pan=0.25)
    keys = s.track("keys", ep(index=1.5, decay=3.2, tine=0.3), program=5, level=-21, rev=0.28,
                   chorus=0.5, duck=0.12)
    pad = s.track("pad", warm_pad(cutoff=1300.0, a=0.9, r=1.8), program=89, level=-24, rev=0.35,
                  chorus=0.6, duck=0.3, width=1.3)
    arp = s.track("arp", pluck(cutoff=700.0, fd=0.2, r=0.2), program=84, level=-27, dly=0.35,
                  rev=0.2, pan=-0.25)
    bs = s.track("bass", bass(cutoff=300.0, env_amt=3.0, fd=0.18, d=0.5, s=0.8), program=38,
                 level=-18, duck=0.25)
    dr = s.track("drums", drums(kick_decay=1.2, snare_decay=1.3), program=0)
    fxt = s.track("fx", fx(), program=99, level=-27, rev=0.4)
    ARP = ["1", "5", "8", "9", "10", "9", "8", "5"]

    sec = s.section("intro", 4, INTRO_CH)
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, vel=78)
    sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 3)
    sec.mel(bells, BELLS, vel=84)
    pad.automate("gain", [(sec.at(0), -12), (sec.at(2), 0)])
    sec.fx(fxt, "swell", bar=2, beats=8)

    def verse(name, text, drums_on=True):
        sec = s.section(name, 8, VERSE_CH)
        sec.mel(lead, text)
        sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x.....x...x.....", vel=80)
        sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 3)
        sec.bass(bs, "R:q. R:e R:h")
        if drums_on:
            sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"], fills={7: FILL})
            sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0, vel=90)

    def pre(name):
        sec = s.section(name, 4, PRE_CH)
        sec.mel(lead, PRE)
        sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, vel=80)
        sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 3)
        sec.arp(arp, ARP, lo="Db4", rate=0.25, vel=66)
        sec.bass(bs, "R:e R R R R R R R")
        sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"], fills={3: SW_FILL_TOMS})
        sec.fx(fxt, "reverse", bar=2, beats=8)

    def chorus(name, bells_double=False):
        sec = s.section(name, 8, CHORUS_CH)
        sec.mel(lead, CHORUS)
        if bells_double:
            sec.mel(bells, CHORUS, transpose=12, vel=80)
        sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x..x..x...x..x..", vel=84)
        sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 4)
        sec.arp(arp, ARP, lo="Db4", rate=0.25, vel=70)
        sec.bass(bs, "R:e R O R R R O R")
        sec.drums(dr, DR["chorus"], fills={7: FILL})
        sec.hit(dr, "crash", 0)

    verse("verse", VERSE_A, drums_on=False)
    verse("verse 2", VERSE_B)
    pre("pre")
    chorus("chorus")

    sec = s.section("interlude", 4, INTRO_CH)
    sec.mel(bells, BELLS)
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x.....x...x.....", vel=80)
    sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 3)
    sec.bass(bs, "R:q. R:e R:h")
    sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"])

    verse("verse 3", VERSE_B)
    pre("pre 2")
    chorus("chorus 2")

    sec = s.section("bridge", 8, BRIDGE_CH, "Bb", "natural minor")
    sec.mel(lead, BRIDGE)
    sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Bb4", 4)
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, hold=False, rhythm="x.......x.......", vel=76)
    sec.bass(bs, "R:w")
    sec.drums(dr, DR["bridge"], bars=(4, 8), fills={7: FILL})
    sec.fx(fxt, "riser", bar=6, beats=8)

    s.keys.append((s.cursor, "Db", "major"))
    chorus("final chorus", bells_double=True)

    sec = s.section("outro", 6, OUTRO_CH)
    sec.mel(lead, OUTRO)
    sec.pad(keys, "Eb4", "Bb5", 4, vel=76)
    sec.pad(pad, "Db3", "Ab4", 4)
    sec.bass(bs, "R:w", bars=(0, 5))
    sec.arp(arp, ARP, lo="Db4", rate=0.5, vel=62, bars=(0, 4))
    sec.drums(dr, DR["verse"], bars=(0, 4))
    sec.hit(dr, "crash", 4, vel=86)
    return s
